question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        birth_date,
        CAST(date(birth_date) AS DATE) AS birth_date_dt
    FROM mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 20 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 30 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 40 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 >= 50 AND (current_date - u.birth_date_dt) / 365.0 < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages u
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category 
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END
